motions.item_title: Motion to go into Closed Session
motions.text: That a closed meeting of Administration and Finance Committee, Community and Health Services Committee, and Sustainability, Infrastructure, and Development Committee be held on December 3, 2024 at 9:15 a.m. in the Waterloo County Room , in accordance with Section 239 of the “Municipal Act, 2001”, for the purposes of considering the following subject matters: Receiving information regarding employee negotiations related to union matters; Receiving information regarding employee negotiations related to union matters; Receiving information regarding employee negotiations related to union matters; Receiving information related to labour relations regarding the Ontario Municipal Employee Retirement System; Receiving information related to proposed land lease agreement in Cambridge; Receiving information related to proposed land lease agreement in Cambridge; and Receiving advice that is subject to solicitor-client privilege related to confidential information supplied by the province and an agency of the province. Receiving information and providing direction that is subject to solicitor-client privilege related to a decision of a tribunal.
motions.text_html:
That a closed meeting of Administration and Finance Committee, Community and Health Services Committee, and Sustainability, Infrastructure, and Development Committee be held on December 3, 2024 at 9:15 a.m. in the Waterloo County Room , in accordance with Section 239 of the “Municipal Act, 2001”, for the purposes of considering the following subject matters:

  1. Receiving information regarding employee negotiations related to union matters;
  2. Receiving information regarding employee negotiations related to union matters;
  3. Receiving information regarding employee negotiations related to union matters;
  4. Receiving information related to labour relations regarding the Ontario Municipal Employee Retirement System;
  5. Receiving information related to proposed land lease agreement in Cambridge;
  6. Receiving information related to proposed land lease agreement in Cambridge; and 
  7. Receiving advice that is subject to solicitor-client privilege related to confidential information supplied by the province and an agency of the province. 
  8. Receiving information and providing direction that is subject to solicitor-client privilege related to a decision of a tribunal.

motions.item_title: Motion to go into All Councils
motions.text: That the Regional Municipality of Waterloo authorize participating in an All Councils meeting on December 6, 2024 at 2:00 p.m. to be held at Centre in the Square.
motions.text_html: That the Regional Municipality of Waterloo authorize participating in an All Councils meeting on December 6, 2024 at 2:00 p.m. to be held at Centre in the Square.

motions.item_title: Enactment Of By-laws – First, Second & Third Readings
motions.text: That the following by-laws be approved.

That a By-law to authorize the borrowing upon ten year instalment debentures in the aggregate principal amount of $35,657,000 for Capital Works of The Corporation of the City of Kitchener, be read a first, second and third time, finally passed and numbered 24-045, be signed by the Regional Chair and Regional Clerk and sealed with the Regional Seal.
motions.text_html: That a By-law to authorize the borrowing upon ten year instalment debentures in the aggregate principal amount of $35,657,000 for Capital Works of The Corporation of the City of Kitchener, be read a first, second and third time, finally passed and numbered 24-045, be signed by the Regional Chair and Regional Clerk and sealed with the Regional Seal.

motions.text: That a By-law to authorize the borrowing upon instalment debentures in the aggregate principal amount of $38,343,000 (10 year instalment debentures in the aggregate principal amount of $14,343,000 and 20 year instalment debentures in the aggregate principal amount of $24,000,000) for capital works of The Regional Municipality of Waterloo, be read a first, second and third time, finally passed and numbered 24-046, be signed by the Regional Chair and Regional Clerk and sealed with the Regional Seal.
motions.text_html: That a By-law to authorize the borrowing upon instalment debentures in the aggregate principal amount of $38,343,000 (10 year instalment debentures in the aggregate principal amount of $14,343,000 and 20 year instalment debentures in the aggregate principal amount of $24,000,000) for capital works of The Regional Municipality of Waterloo, be read a first, second and third time, finally passed and numbered 24-046, be signed by the Regional Chair and Regional Clerk and sealed with the Regional Seal.

motions.text: That a By-law to provide for the borrowing of the aggregate of the principal amounts authorized by By-laws numbered 24-045 and 24-046 and for the issuing of one series of instalment debentures therefor in the aggregate principal amount of $74,000,000 (10 year instalment debentures in the aggregate principal amount of $50,000,000 and 20 year instalment debentures in the aggregate principal amount of $24,000,000), be read a first, second and third time, finally passed and numbered 24-047, be signed by the Regional Chair and Regional Clerk and sealed with the Regional Seal.
motions.text_html: That a By-law to provide for the borrowing of the aggregate of the principal amounts authorized by By-laws numbered 24-045 and 24-046 and for the issuing of one series of instalment debentures therefor in the aggregate principal amount of $74,000,000 (10 year instalment debentures in the aggregate principal amount of $50,000,000 and 20 year instalment debentures in the aggregate principal amount of $24,000,000), be read a first, second and third time, finally passed and numbered 24-047, be signed by the Regional Chair and Regional Clerk and sealed with the Regional Seal.

motions.text: That a By-law to Confirm the Proceedings of the Council of the Regional Municipality of Waterloo at this Meeting Held on December 3, 2024 be read a first, second and third time, finally passed and numbered 24-048, be signed by the Regional Chair and Regional Clerk and sealed with the Regional Seal.
motions.text_html: That a By-law to Confirm the Proceedings of the Council of the Regional Municipality of Waterloo at this Meeting Held on December 3, 2024 be read a first, second and third time, finally passed and numbered 24-048, be signed by the Regional Chair and Regional Clerk and sealed with the Regional Seal.

motions.text: That the meeting adjourn at 9:07 a.m.
